head: 72a8b927c0d2b96b7d3df41114969aa620bb9602

findings.summary: Metadata lookup exceptions are cached as table absence, enabling the public legacy description|raw branch when sidecar detection actually failed.
findings.required_action: Use tri-state detection; only a successful lookup proving absence may select legacy fallback. Errors must fail closed.

findings.summary: Allowlisted view/image/blog/... paths are emitted unchanged; relative URLs can resolve incorrectly on nested SEO routes or subdirectory installs.
findings.required_action: Resolve local assets against a trusted catalog base while preserving scheme/host rejection.

findings.summary: Public block language is selected from nonempty legacy HTML description; an intentionally empty snapshot can cause English sidecar content to replace the active-language document.
findings.required_action: Define sidecar-aware active-language-first selection and explicit English fallback behavior.

findings.summary: Sidecar/post/descriptions/SEO deletion is a sequence without a transaction and the migration has no foreign-key cascade.
findings.required_action: Wrap deletion in an InnoDB transaction with rollback or accept documented partial deletion risk.

readiness_gate: Resolve both P1 findings before release.
Decide and cover P2 language and deletion semantics.
Run explicitly authorized E2E only in an isolated disposable environment after owner-managed F9-12 migration.
